body_text:
Cauchy's integral theorem. Let $U\subseteq\mathbb{C}$ be open and
simply connected, let $f:U\to\mathbb{C}$ be holomorphic, and let
$\gamma$ be a closed piecewise continuously differentiable path in
$U$. Then $\int_\gamma f(z)\,dz=0$. More generally, simple
connectedness may be replaced by the requirement that $\gamma$ be
null-homologous in $U$.
